description: This file defines the Pool class within the Goteo project, managing user reserve balances (gots) obtained through credit-type contributions to projects. It includes methods for retrieving, calculating, saving, and modifying user pools, as well as handling investments related to the pool.

classes.name: Pool
classes.description: Represents and manages a user's reserve of 'gots' obtained through credit contributions, including methods for retrieval, calculation, validation, and modification of the reserve.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves or initializes the pool for a given user; throws exception if user not found.

methods.name: calculate
methods.description: Recalculates the pool amount based on the user's investment data; optionally saves the updated amount.

methods.name: getAmount
methods.description: Returns the current amount of 'gots' in the user's pool.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the pool data ensuring that required fields are set.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the pool data into the database.

methods.name: refundInvest
methods.description: Refunds an investment to the user's pool; marked as deprecated.

methods.name: withdraw
methods.description: Withdraws an amount from the pool, updating the reserve.

methods.name: lastProject
methods.description: Retrieves the last project associated with the user's investments in the pool.
